svg.title: dynamic_cast memory layout diagram
svg.desc: Shows what happens in memory for a successful and a failed dynamic_cast, including the heap object, vptr, vtable, and RTTI chain.

g.text: Follows vptr → vtable → reads type_info → "Derived" matches target → returns the same address as bp
Follows vptr → reads type_info → "Derived" ≠ "Other", no "Other" in hierarchy → returns nullptr, no crash

svg.text: Why a virtual function is required
Without at least one virtual function the compiler emits no vtable and no vptr.
With no vptr there is nowhere to store the RTTI pointer → dynamic_cast cannot work.
